records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of [the] sons of Korah. A psalm.

en.L: For the director: of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
en.B: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. A psalm.
en.R: For the leader of the music. By the family of Korah. A song.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur : des fils de Coré. Un psaume.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. Des fils de Coré. Un psaume.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. De la famille de Coré. Un chant.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, probably the leader of the temple music.

decisions.choice: the sons of Korah: a family of Levite singers
decisions.reason: The descendants of Korah, a Levite (Numbers 26:11), served as gatekeepers and singers at the temple (1 Chronicles 9:19; 2 Chronicles 20:19). Eleven psalms carry their name (42-49, 84-85, 87-88). "Of" may mean the psalm belongs to their collection or was written by one of them.

source.text: רָצִ֣יתָ יְהוָ֣ה אַרְצֶ֑ךָ שַׁ֝֗בְתָּ שְׁבִ֣ית יַעֲקֹֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: You were favorable, YHWH, [to] your land; you turned back [the] fortunes of Jacob.

en.L: You were favorable, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, [to] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} land; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turned back the fortunes of Jacob.
en.B: You were pleased with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} land, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought Jacob's fortunes back.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} were kind to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} land. \q You made things good again for Jacob's people.

fr.L: Tu as été favorable, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, [à] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pays ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as ramené les captifs de Jacob.
fr.B: Tu as aimé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pays, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as rétabli le sort de Jacob.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as été bon pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} pays. \q Tu as rendu le bonheur au peuple de Jacob.

decisions.choice: fortunes: the form as read
decisions.reason: The word follows the form the Hebrew text's notes say to read; the written form is spelled slightly differently. Both mean the same.

decisions.choice: turned back the fortunes: restored what was lost
alternatives: brought back the captives of Jacob
decisions.reason: The phrase (shuv shevut) means to turn a people's situation around, to restore them (14:7; Jeremiah 30:3). It is often used of the return from exile, and the psalm may look back on that return, while the present (verses 5-8) is still hard.

decisions.choice: you were favorable ... you turned back: what God did before
decisions.reason: Verses 2-4 recall what God has already done; verses 5-8 ask him to do it again.

decisions.choice: made things good again for Jacob's people
decisions.reason: Readable explains the phrase (m2).

decisions.choice: "ramené les captifs" at Literal; "rétabli le sort" at Balanced
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the phrase as restoring what was lost. Literal keeps the old picture of bringing back the captives, which is one way the Hebrew phrase has been heard; Balanced says the general sense, as the English "brought Jacob's fortunes back" does.

source.text: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כָל־חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: You lifted [the] iniquity of your people; you covered all their sin. Selah.

en.L: You lifted the iniquity of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} covered all their sin. Selah
en.B: You took away the guilt of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people \q and covered over all their sins. Selah
en.R: You forgave {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people's sins. \q You covered over every wrong they did. Selah

fr.L: Tu as ôté la faute de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as couvert tout leur péché. Sélah
fr.B: Tu as enlevé la culpabilité de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple \q et couvert tous ses péchés. Sélah
fr.R: Tu as pardonné les péchés de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple. \q Tu as couvert tout le mal qu’il avait fait. Sélah

decisions.choice: lifted the iniquity: took away the guilt
decisions.reason: To lift or carry away guilt (nasa' 'avon) is to forgive it (32:5; Exodus 34:7).

decisions.choice: covered: hid from view, forgave
decisions.reason: Sin covered by God is no longer held against the sinner (32:1).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

records.literal_gloss: You withdrew all your fury; you turned back from [the] burning of your anger.

en.L: You withdrew all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turned back from the burning of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger.
en.B: You drew back all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turned away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} blazing anger.
en.R: You held back all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} fury. \q You turned away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} burning anger.

fr.L: Tu as retiré toute {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es revenu de l’ardeur de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère.
fr.B: Tu as retenu toute {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} t’es détourné de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère brûlante.
fr.R: Tu as arrêté toute {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fureur. \q Tu as laissé de côté {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère brûlante.

decisions.choice: the burning of your anger: fierce anger
decisions.reason: Anger is pictured as fire (78:49; Exodus 32:12).

source.text: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּֽעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Restore us, God of our salvation, and break off your vexation with us.

en.L: Restore us, God of our salvation, \q and break off {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} vexation with us.
en.B: Bring us back, God who saves us, \q and put an end to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} displeasure with us.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the one who saves us. \q Bring us back again! Stop being angry with us.

fr.L: Restaure-nous, Dieu de notre salut, \q et romps {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} chagrin contre nous.
fr.B: Ramène-nous, Dieu qui nous sauves, \q et mets fin à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} mécontentement envers nous.
fr.R: Ô Dieu, c’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui nous sauves. \q Ramène-nous encore vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! Ne sois plus en colère contre nous.

decisions.choice: restore us: bring us back
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) is the word of verse 2 ("turned back") and of the refrain in Psalm 80. The people ask God to restore them again, or to turn them back to himself.

decisions.choice: vexation: grief-filled anger
decisions.reason: The word (ka'as) is anger stirred up by being provoked (6:8; 10:14).

decisions.choice: God who saves us (B); the one who saves us (R)
decisions.reason: As in 79:9.

source.text: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּֽאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Forever will you be angry with us? Will you draw out your anger to generation and generation?

en.L: Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be angry with us forever? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} draw out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger to generation and generation?
en.B: Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be angry with us for all time? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stretch out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger to every generation?
en.R: Are {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} going to stay angry with us forever? \q Will {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger go on for our children and grandchildren too?

fr.L: Seras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} irrité contre nous pour toujours ? \q Prolongeras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère de génération en génération ?
fr.B: Seras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} en colère contre nous à jamais ? \q Étendras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère sur toutes les générations ?
fr.R: Vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rester en colère contre nous pour toujours ? \q Est-ce que {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère va durer aussi pour nos enfants et nos petits-enfants ?

decisions.choice: to generation and generation: to all generations
decisions.reason: As in 79:13, the phrase means all the generations to come.

decisions.choice: our children and grandchildren
decisions.reason: Readable gives a concrete picture (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Will not you return [and] give us life, and your people rejoice in you?

en.L: Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not again give us life, \q so that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people may rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.B: Will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} not bring us back to life once more, \q and let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people be glad in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}?
en.R: Please give us new life again! \q Then {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people will be happy because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Ne nous rendras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas la vie, \q afin que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple se réjouisse en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ?
fr.B: Ne vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pas nous faire revivre encore, \q pour que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple trouve sa joie en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ?
fr.R: Redonne-nous la vie, s’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît ! \q Alors {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple sera heureux grâce à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}.

decisions.choice: return and give us life: give us life again
decisions.reason: "Return" (shuv) before another verb means to do it again (71:20). It also echoes the "turning" of verses 2, 4 and 5.

decisions.choice: give us life: revive us
decisions.reason: The verb (chayah, intensive) means to bring back to life, as in 80:19.

decisions.choice: Please give us new life again!
alternatives: Will you not give us life again?
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question, which is a request, into a plain request.

records.literal_gloss: Show us, YHWH, your loyal love, and your salvation give to us.

en.L: Show us, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, \q and give us {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.B: Let us see {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and give us {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, show us {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, \q and save us.

fr.L: Montre-nous, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, \q et donne-nous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.B: Fais-nous voir {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et donne-nous {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8).

decisions.choice: your salvation: your rescue
decisions.reason: The word (yesha') is deliverance from danger and trouble, here the restoring of the people.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: save us
decisions.reason: Readable uses the verb.

decisions.choice: ḥesed is "amour loyal" at Literal and "amour fidèle" at Balanced and Readable, for Psalms 84-104
decisions.reason: As the terms note for Psalms sets. The word is love that keeps faith with a covenant; "amour loyal" keeps the English Literal's sense, and "amour fidèle" is the more natural French at the other levels.

source.text: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֪ל׀יְה֫וָ֥ה כִּ֤י׀יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְֽאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: I will hear what will say God, YHWH, for he will speak peace to his people and to his faithful [ones], and let them not return to folly.

en.L: I will hear what God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, will say, \q for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will speak peace to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful ones; \q but let them not turn back to folly.
en.B: I am listening for what God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, will say: \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will speak of peace to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, to those who are loyal to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q only let them not slide back into foolishness.
en.R: I will pay attention to what God, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, says. \q He promises peace to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, to those who are faithful to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q But they must not go back to doing foolish things.

fr.L: J’écouterai ce que dira Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} parlera de paix à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple et à {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} fidèles ; \q mais qu’ils ne retournent pas à la folie.
fr.B: J’écoute ce que va dire Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} annoncera la paix à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont fidèles ; \q seulement, qu’ils ne retombent pas dans la folie.
fr.R: Je vais faire attention à ce que dit Dieu, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. \q Il promet la paix à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, à ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} sont fidèles. \q Mais ils ne doivent pas revenir à leurs folies.

decisions.choice: I will hear: waiting for God's answer
decisions.reason: After the prayer of verses 5-8 one voice, perhaps a priest or prophet, waits for God's reply, and verses 10-14 give it.

decisions.choice: peace: wholeness and well-being
decisions.reason: The word (shalom) means more than the end of war: life made whole and right (29:11; verse 11).

decisions.choice: let them not turn back to folly: the Hebrew text
alternatives: and to those who turn their heart to him (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads the last line as "and to those who turn their heart to him". The Hebrew text warns the people not to go back to their old foolishness.

decisions.choice: folly: moral foolishness
decisions.reason: The word (kislah) is the foolishness of turning away from God, not lack of intelligence (49:14).

source.text: אַ֤ךְ׀קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Surely near to [those] fearing him [is] his salvation, to dwell glory in our land.

en.L: Surely {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} salvation [is] near to those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q that glory may dwell in our land.
en.B: Truly {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} salvation is close at hand for those who fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q so that glory will settle in our land.
en.R: God is ready to save people who honor {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Then {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory will live in our land.

fr.L: Oui, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salut [est] proche de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, \q pour que la gloire habite dans notre pays.
fr.B: Vraiment, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salut est tout près de ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craignent, \q pour que la gloire demeure dans notre pays.
fr.R: Dieu est prêt à sauver ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorent. \q Alors {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire habitera dans notre pays.

decisions.choice: glory dwelling in the land: God's presence among his people
decisions.reason: God's glory (kavod) is his visible presence, which filled the tabernacle (Exodus 40:34) and which Ezekiel saw leave the temple and return to it (Ezekiel 10; 43:2-5). "Dwell" (shakhan) is the word used for God dwelling among his people.

decisions.choice: those who fear him: who revere God
decisions.reason: To fear God is to honor him with awe and obey him (34:8, 10).

decisions.choice: his glory
decisions.reason: Readable says whose glory, as m1 does.

records.literal_gloss: Loyal love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss.

en.L: Loyal love and faithfulness meet; \q righteousness and peace kiss.
en.B: Loyal love and faithfulness meet as friends; \q righteousness and peace greet each other with a kiss.
en.R: Faithful love and loyalty come together. \q What is right and peace kiss each other like friends.

fr.L: L’amour loyal et la fidélité se rencontrent ; \q la justice et la paix s’embrassent.
fr.B: L’amour fidèle et la fidélité se rencontrent comme des amies ; \q la justice et la paix se saluent d’un baiser.
fr.R: L’amour fidèle et la loyauté se retrouvent. \q Ce qui est juste et la paix s’embrassent comme des amies.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up (5:8). Here it is one of four qualities pictured as people who meet.

decisions.choice: faithfulness: reliability, truth
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) is what is firm and can be relied on, both truth and faithfulness.

decisions.choice: righteousness: what is right
decisions.reason: The word (tsedeq) is right order, God's and people's, kept in the land (verse 14).

decisions.choice: meet ... kiss: qualities pictured as friends
decisions.reason: Loyal love, faithfulness, righteousness and peace are pictured as people who meet and greet one another. When God comes back, they are found together in the land.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: loyalty; what is right
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words: "loyalty" because "faithful love" is already used for chesed (m2, m3).

decisions.choice: "L'amour fidèle et la fidélité" at Balanced, keeping both terms of the note though they share a root in French
decisions.reason: The terms note gives "amour fidèle" for ḥesed and "fidélité" for ʾemet at Balanced. The two French words sound alike, as the two Hebrew qualities belong together; Readable avoids the echo with "loyauté", as the English Readable says "loyalty".

source.text: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: Faithfulness from [the] earth springs up, and righteousness from heaven looks down.

en.L: Faithfulness springs up from the earth, \q and righteousness looks down from heaven.
en.B: Faithfulness grows up out of the earth, \q and righteousness gazes down from heaven.
en.R: Loyalty grows up from the ground like a plant. \q What is right looks down from the sky.

fr.L: La fidélité germe de la terre, \q et la justice regarde du haut des cieux.
fr.B: La fidélité pousse hors de la terre, \q et la justice se penche du haut des cieux.
fr.R: La loyauté sort du sol comme une plante. \q Ce qui est juste regarde d’en haut, depuis le ciel.

decisions.choice: springs up ... looks down: earth and heaven together
decisions.reason: Faithfulness grows from the earth like a plant, and righteousness leans down from heaven to meet it: heaven and earth are joined (Isaiah 45:8).

decisions.choice: loyalty; what is right
decisions.reason: As in verse 11.

source.text: גַּם־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Also YHWH will give the good, and our land will give its produce.

en.L: Also {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will give what is good, \q and our land will give its produce.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will surely give good things, \q and our soil will bring forth its crops.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will give us good things, \q and our land will grow its crops.

fr.L: Aussi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnera ce qui est bon, \q et notre terre donnera son produit.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} donnera, oui, de bonnes choses, \q et notre sol fera pousser ses récoltes.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous donnera de bonnes choses, \q et notre terre produira ses récoltes.

decisions.choice: the land will give its produce
decisions.reason: The promise of the covenant (Leviticus 26:4), as in 67:7.

decisions.choice: the good: blessing, here rain and harvest
decisions.reason: "The good" is what God gives, especially rain (Deuteronomy 28:12).

source.text: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Righteousness before him will walk, and will make into a way his footsteps.

en.L: Righteousness will walk before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, \q and will make {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} footsteps into a way.
en.B: Righteousness will walk ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q and make a road for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} steps.
en.R: What is right will go ahead of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} \q and prepare a path for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} feet.

fr.L: La justice marchera devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q et fera de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pas un chemin.
fr.B: La justice marchera en avant de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q et tracera une route pour {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pas.
fr.R: Ce qui est juste ira devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} \q et préparera un chemin pour {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} pieds.

decisions.choice: righteousness before him: a herald going ahead
decisions.reason: A king's herald went ahead to prepare his road (Isaiah 40:3). God comes to his land with righteousness leading the way (89:15).

decisions.choice: make his footsteps into a way: prepare a path for him
alternatives: set (his people) on the way of his steps
decisions.reason: The words can mean that righteousness prepares a road for God's steps, or that it makes a way for people to follow in his steps.

decisions.choice: go ahead; prepare a path
alternatives: walk before; make into a way
decisions.reason: Readable uses plain words (m2).
